paite: Huchibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, haichi poi nanungzaw pen adot pat tungna ah khaukhup abawl a; ngai dih ua, kumpipa tangseu khit a pou nanungzaw ahi.
heading: Khaupehon Muhna
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.

paite: Huan huchi ahong hi a, huai gam a loupa anek khit nung un, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngaidam in, ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

paite: Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alung hei in, "TOUPA'N, hiai hong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchibang in, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; huan en dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mei a dou ding in asam a; mei in tui thuk lian akang khin a, gam leng kat a-ut lai hi.
heading: Meikuang Muhna
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, the Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.

paite: Ke'n, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, khawl in ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Lord Yahweh, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

paite: Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alungsim hei in, "Toupa PATHIAN in, huai leng ahong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Hichibang in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, TOUPA bel ulum a bawl baang kiang ah adingh a, akhut a ulum toh.
english: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Amos, bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ulum," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N, “Ngai in, ka mi, Israelte lak ah ulum ka koih ding a; amau ka paikheng nawnta kei ding;
english: Yahweh said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

paite: Isak mun sangte ahong segawp ding a, Israel mun siangthoute hihsiat ahi ding ua; Jeroboam inkote namsau in ka dou ding," achi hi.
english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”

paite: Huan Bethel kho siampu Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kiang ah, "Amos in Israel inkote lak ah nang hon kalh a; gam in athu tengteng athuak thei kei," chi in.
heading: Amos Leh Amaziah
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.

paite: Amos in lah hichi in achi ngal a, “Jeroboam namsau in asi ding, pel lou in agam a kipan in Israel sal in apikhe ding," chi in thu akhak hi.
english: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

paite: Huan Amos kiang ah Amaziah in, "Aw nang zawlnei, kuan inla, Judah gam ah taimang in, huai ah an ne inla, thu hilh in.
english: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,

paite: Himahleh Bethel ah thu hilh nawn ke'n; kumpipa mun siangthou leh kumpipa' inn ahih ziak in," achi lai hi.
english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

paite: Huan Amaziah kiang ah Amos in, "Zawlnei ka hi kei a, zawlnei tapa leng ka hi sam kei; ganhon vengpa leh theipi sing kempa ka hi zaw hi.
english: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Kuan inla, ka mi Israelte kiang ah thu gen in,' hon chi hi.
english: and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

paite: Huchi in tu in TOUPA thu za in; nang Israel kalh in thu gen ke'nla, Isak inkote kalh in thu khak ke'n, na chih.
english: Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’

paite: Huaiziak in ToUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Khopi ah na zi kizuaknu ahi ding a, na tapate, na tanute namsau in apuk ding ua, tehna khau in na gam ahawm ding ua; nang leng siang lou mun ah na si ding a; pel lou in Israel a gam a kipan sal in apimang ding uh, achi,' " chi in adawng hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”
